authorizationBindingConstraint: Readiness and each prerequisite report bind exact whole authorization SHA and started/completed timestamps within that grant; new grant cannot consume old report without violating current source.
selectedAuthorizationStrategy: Coordinator explicitly chose one immutable total grant for all four tokens; formal execution additionally waits for coordinator receipt read and explicit start after same-grant prerequisite/cleanup pass.
boundCaveat: Sum is child episode timeout budget, not strict whole-stage wall clock: identity probes, repeated prerequisite/artifact validation and process-stop overhead are outside parent episode waits. Recommended finite windows are conservative operational planning allowances, not measured durations or new per-episode caps.
